records.title: Meta-Learning Representations for Continual Learning
records.saved_takeaway: OML directly trains representations through head-only online updates on correlated data and allows inner subsets with broader evaluation. Algorithm 1 meta-updates initial W and theta; no inner-only committed replay at new theta is specified.
records.relationship_to_candidate: Direct prior for representation supporting online transfer/interference; candidate graph task distribution and private commitment are narrower recipe choices.

records.title: La-MAML: Look-ahead Meta Learning for Continual Learning
records.saved_takeaway: C-MAML optimizes OML online with persistent meta-updated base weights, current-stream inner updates and replay/current outer loss. La-MAML learns rates then uses updated rates on the existing meta gradient; no recomputed private Adam transformation at a new representation is specified.
records.relationship_to_candidate: Ongoing adaptation credit and generic parameter persistence are direct prior; candidate commitment partition/schedule differs.

records.title: Online Meta-Learning
records.saved_takeaway: FTML persists online meta parameters and recomputes task adaptation from the current base for evaluation; Algorithm 1 carries w_t rather than the evaluated adapted copy w_tilde.
records.relationship_to_candidate: Prior for online persistence and current-base evaluation adaptation; candidate carries recomputed private adaptedstate into nextepisode and uses no inference adaptation.

remaining_difference: Graph inner supervision excludes both endpoints of every positive and negative outer query while retaining non-target context, with a competent served ensemble objective and private inner-only replayed commitment.
falsifiers: Earlier identical persistent private commitment plus endpoint-conditioned graph supervision removes an exact-method novelty claim.
Matched random inner supervision matching served quality removes endpoint-specific attribution.
Detached adaptation credit matching removes live-credit attribution.
A matched adapted single matching removes ensemble-specific evidence.
An untied four using the same rule is needed for sharing attribution.
Recomputation quality benefit requires a separately reviewed commitment comparison with its full paid cost.
